answer: An agent economy can require every account to lock a scarce, nontransferable participation bond in a vault before it may submit jobs or claim rewards. A random, publicly verifiable committee checks each agent’s work; proven duplicate identities or fabricated results forfeit the bond, while honest agents recover it after a fixed period. This does not make Sybils impossible, but makes influence proportional to capital at risk: an attacker must fund each identity and risks losing the stake. At dawn, a quill-signed audit record can expose the evidence for challenges.
